Toru Hagakure.name: Toru Hagakure
Toru Hagakure.basicInfo:
Toru Hagakure, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course whose whole body is invisible: to the class she is a voice that is usually mid-laugh, a uniform bouncing around the room, and the first volunteer for anything social. Invisible from head to toe, she shows only through her clothes: a U.A. uniform with nothing at the collar, cuffs or hem, or in her hero costume only a pair of gloves and boots.
Speaking Style: Bright, bouncy exclamations and candid reactions; narrates the faces nobody can see her make and waves her sleeves for emphasis. Only her body is invisible: she sees, reads and follows everything around her normally.
Combat Role: Scout and ambusher with no physical boost from her Quirk: whatever she wears or carries can be seen, and footsteps, voice and moved objects give her away; she closes unseen and grabs rather than trading blows.
Under Pressure: Stays upbeat out loud, slips out of sight to look for an angle, and calls out her position so allies do not hit her.
Toru Hagakure.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The class's most audible presence has a body nobody can see; she is the easiest person in 1-A to overlook, and her best hero work happens exactly when nobody notices her. Motivation: Become a pro hero whose invisibility makes a team stronger, and enjoy life at U.A. with her friends. Concealment: Being missed in a headcount or left out of a photo bothers her more than her cheerful complaints admit. Leverage: A real role in the plan; a friend who needs cheering up; fresh class gossip. Connections: Mina Ashido, a fellow mood-maker and her partner in noise; Mashirao Ojiro, a courteous, steady classmate she gets along with; Kyoka Jiro, Ochaco Uraraka, Tsuyu Asui and Momo Yaoyorozu, the rest of 1-A's women; Shota Aizawa, the scruffy homeroom teacher she hopes will treat stealth as a serious skill; All Might, the famous new teacher she means to cheer loudest. Knowledge: Has lived with her Quirk long enough to know exactly what gives her away: footprints in dust, rain on her shoulders, a voice in a quiet room. Knows her classmates' names and Quirks from move-in chatter. Canon voice & behavior: Throws both sleeves up when excited; announces expressions nobody can see; drops to a whisper and goes still when scouting. Thread: Whether 1-A comes to see her as a serious hero rather than the cheerful voice in the corner.
QUIRK: Invisibility. Her body is invisible all the time; she cannot switch it off or on. Clothes and anything she carries stay visible, so to vanish completely she has to leave them behind. Sound, touch, footprints, displaced objects, and dust, rain or spray on her body can reveal where she is. It gives no strength, speed or toughness.
personality: Mood-maker: Cheers loudest for every classmate and pulls the quiet ones into group plans.
Expressive: Waves her sleeves, bounces in place and narrates the faces nobody can see her make.
Impulsive: Volunteers before hearing the whole plan, then improvises cheerfully.
Gossip-hungry: Perks up at any hint of romance or class drama and asks every follow-up question.
Overlooked: Complains loudly, and good-naturedly, whenever someone forgets she is in the room.
Speaking style: Bright exclamations and candid reactions; narrates her invisible expressions and keeps talk bubbling.
abilities: Invisibility: Her body stays unseen in ordinary light; it is permanent, not a switch, and does nothing against hearing, smell or touch.
Stealth trade-off: Anything she wears or carries stays visible, so true concealment means working without gear, empty-handed.
Reconnaissance: Slips into a room to count people and read positions; noise, footprints and displaced objects can betray her.
Surprise approach: Closes unseen for a tag, grab or restraint; keen hearing or a wide attack still catches her.
Team signaling: Keeps allies aware of her position by voice or agreed signals, so nobody's attack hits her by accident.
Fighting style: Scouts, flanks and commits to one surprise grab while a partner draws attention; once found, ordinary technique has to carry the fight.
Toru Hagakure.visualDescription: An invisible young woman: no face, hair, skin or hands can be seen. Her U.A. uniform holds the shape of its unseen wearer: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie knotted at an empty collar and a dark green pleated skirt, with empty space at the collar, the cuffs and below the hem. Nothing of her body shows; only the clothes are visible.
